messages:
maya_sales: heads-up: NovoMed wants to run a 60-day pilot. asking for one-off pilot invoice $6k + 10h remote setup. they also redlined the DPA to 90-day log retention (we default 30). can legal/finance weigh in?
lina_legal: please attach their redline. 90d is material; ask for justification and propose 30d default + paid extension. also need subprocessors list tightened.
omar_se: on acceptance: they want 3 endpoints at ~2k rps total, p50 < 120ms. we can do but recommend optional dedicated pool for consistency.
tyler_finance: net terms: they asked net45; finance prefers net30 for pilots. on convert credit: if we allow credit to month1, need cap and a 60/90d window defined.
maya_sales: customer requested credit applied if contract signed within 90d. can we be flexible to 60d?
lina_legal: propose compromise: default 30d retention; 90d available as scoped addendum (charges apply). for convert credit offer 90d but require purchase order + signed orderform. i'll draft redline.
procurement_bot: routing note: customer will sign via DocuSign; please provide signer names and invoice billing info.
contracts_bot: SOC2/infra pack available at internal link (access: legal, sales, secops).
omar_se: SSQ has a few infra items (VPC peering, key mgmt). HSM request would escalate. otherwise nothing blocking. i'll fill infra Qs by EOD.
maya_sales: ordering snippet to include optional line: "Dedicated capacity: $1,200/mo". put as checkbox so PO separates it.
tyler_finance: optional capacity okay as add-on. net terms decision: will confirm by COB.
lina_legal: uploaded redline to /sales/novomed/pilot/redline_2377654321.docx. changes: 30d default retention, data deletion timeline, subprocessors narrowed, convert-credit clause with 90d option and cap.
maya_sales: scheduled call with customer 3:30p to ask about 60d vs 90d on credit and retention.
procurement_bot: once redline accepted, I will create DocuSign envelope. need finalized doc and signer emails.
omar_se: SSQ infra answers uploaded to same folder.
maya_sales: action list: lina finalize redline today, omar finish SSQ, tyler confirm net terms, procurement_bot prep DocuSign once final. target: PO signed by Fri.
lina_legal: added SLA language: no SLA for pilot; production SLA negotiable (eg 99.9% with credit cap 10x monthly fee). included fallback language.
maya_sales: thanks all. i will update customer after 3:30 call. :thumbsup:"
